# Volume 1 timeline

## CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised

**[Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) spots [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) driving off in his best clothes, which piques her curiosity. She visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to investigate, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reveals that [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) has gone to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) to fetch an orphan boy they are adopting to help on the farm. Mrs. Rachel voices strong disapproval and concern over the risks of taking in a stranger child before departing to spread the news.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P25](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0025)_

## CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

**[Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) arrives at [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station expecting to pick up an orphan boy, only to discover a young girl waiting for him instead. Unable to bring himself to tell her about the mistake, he decides to bring her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and let [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) deal with it. As they begin their drive, the girl talks incessantly, expressing her imagination and delight, which [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) finds surprisingly enjoyable.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P6](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027)_

**[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) drives the young girl through the blossom-covered [Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue) and past Barry's pond, listening as she renames the landmarks and talks enthusiastically. As they arrive at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) feels an increasing sense of dread about the impending revelation that a boy was expected instead.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P44](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P53](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0053), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P70](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P74](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0074)_

## CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is shocked when [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) arrives home with a girl instead of the expected boy, causing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to burst into tears upon realizing she is unwanted. After a quiet supper where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is too heartbroken to eat, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) puts her to bed in the east gable room. Downstairs, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) suggests keeping [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to help her, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) insists she must be returned to the asylum.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060)_

## CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), marvels at the beautiful scenery, and eats a quiet breakfast with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). She helps [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) with the household chores and gives names to the bedroom cherry tree and a geranium. After dinner, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) set off in the buggy for [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to resolve Anne's placement with Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P1](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P19](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P27](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P42](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0042)_

## CHAPTER V. Anne’s History

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — During their drive along the shore road, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to share the facts of her life. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recounts her upbringing as an orphan who worked for Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) and Mrs. [Hammond](../character/hammond.md) before being sent to the asylum, causing [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to feel pity for her hard life.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021)_

## CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Peter Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visit Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) to address the mix-up regarding Anne's adoption. When the harsh Mrs. [Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md) offers to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a servant, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitates and decides to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home first. Later at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) to keep [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and adopt her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P18](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)_

## CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) up to bed and instructs her to fold her clothes and say her prayers. Discovering [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never prayed before, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) has her improvise a prayer at her knee, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ends like a letter. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) then goes downstairs to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), resolved to teach [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) proper religious and practical manners.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P1](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P13](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P21](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029)_

## CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) have decided to let her stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), sending [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) into tears of joy. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) then instructs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to memorize the Lord's Prayer, though Anne's vivid imagination repeatedly distracts her until [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sends her up to her gable room.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P6](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P48](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0048)_

## CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and insults Anne's looks, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to fly into a furious rage and yell at her. After an offended Mrs. Rachel departs, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her bedroom and orders her to stay in her room until she agrees to apologize.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P47](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0047)_

## CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and persuades her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can come out of isolation. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) agrees and delivers a dramatic, melodramatic apology that completely appeases Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md). On the walk home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) expresses her joy at having a real home, touching Marilla's heart.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P16](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P49](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0049)_

## CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) shows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) three plain new dresses she has made for her, disappointing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) who longs for fashionable puffed sleeves. The following day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends Sunday school alone in her plain clothes decorated with wild flowers and finds the experience dull, especially compared to the other girls in puffed sleeves. Upon returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) a candid report of the day's events and services.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P1](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P9](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P21](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0021)_

## CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her decorated hat before taking her to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). In the garden, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) become instant friends and swear a solemn oath of friendship. Returning home happily, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a treat of chocolates from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits to herself that she is becoming fond of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P42](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046)_

## CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rushes inside after staying out late talking with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and eagerly asks [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) for permission to attend the upcoming Sunday-school picnic. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees and offers to bake a basket for her, which prompts a delighted embrace from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks incessantly about her playhouse with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and her intense excitement for the picnic, while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) worries [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sets her heart too much on things.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P7](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P18](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0018)_

## CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — When Marilla's amethyst brooch goes missing, she accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and confines her to her room until she confesses. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invents a dramatic story of losing it so she can attend the picnic, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forbids her from going anyway. Soon after, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the brooch caught in her shawl, apologizes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and sends her off to enjoy the picnic after all.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P14](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P35](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P56](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0056), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P62](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0062)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits her mistake regarding the brooch and forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), allowing her to attend the picnic after all. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns from the picnic overjoyed and describes her wonderful day to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who later admits to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) that she was wrong to force the confession.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P62](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0062), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P65](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0065), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070)_

## CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — During class at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolhouse, [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to get Anne's attention by pulling her hair and calling her "Carrots." Furious at the insult, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashes her slate over Gilbert's head. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand at the blackboard with a message criticizing her temper, and afterward [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ignores Gilbert's contrite attempt to apologize.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — After being publicly humiliated and forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to return to school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she calms down. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is overcome with laughter when she finds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping hysterically over the imaginary future scenario of [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) getting married.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P81](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0081), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P96](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0096)_

## CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invites [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over for afternoon tea while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is away, but mistakenly serves her three glasses of homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) becomes sick and dizzy and has to go home, leading Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) to forbid [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) from playing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ever again.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P12](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P25](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P29](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explains to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) believes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) got [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk and forbidden their friendship. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally served currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, but after visiting Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) fails to change her mind. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to plead with Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) directly, but is turned away, leaving her heartbroken.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P46](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. ## CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a dramatic goodbye after Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) forbids them from playing together. Unhappy with the separation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where her classmates welcome her warmly and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) sends her a secret note. Over the term, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) focuses fiercely on her studies and engages in an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)_

## CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md)** — While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel attend a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes in seeking help for [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), who has severe croup while her parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses her past experience with children to treat [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), saving her life, which leads Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and allow her and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to be best friends once again.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) has forgiven her and invited her over to visit [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) excitedly dashes off to the Barrys' house and later returns overjoyed to recount her reconciliation with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and their wonderful afternoon together.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P46](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend the [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). After enjoying the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed at Diana's house, accidentally leaping onto visiting [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who reacts furiously.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P27](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P58](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0058)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — After discussing her latest blunder with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping onto her bed. Her honest confession and imaginative explanations charm Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) into staying in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and continuing Diana's music lessons.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P66](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0066), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. ## CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her year at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and her outings with school friends. When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sends her to the Barrys' house at dusk, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confesses that she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) imagined the spruce grove was a [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forces a terrified [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk through the woods anyway to cure her of imagining ghosts.

## CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bids farewell to Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) on the last day of school and later shares her excitement about the new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. After preparing extensively for the Allans to come to tea at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bakes a special layer cake, but Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notice something strangely wrong with it upon tasting it.

Mortified by her mistake, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flees to her room in tears, but Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) kindly comforts her and assures her it was an honest mistake.

## CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns from the post office thrilled to have received a written invitation to tea at the manse from Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md). Despite her anxiety about proper etiquette and Matthew's weather forecast, she attends the tea and returns home delighted. Sitting with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) happily recounts her wonderful evening, including news about singing in the choir and [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) hiring a new female teacher.

## CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), [Superintendent Bell](../character/superintendent-bell.md)** — During a game of dares at Diana's party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof and falls, breaking her ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) carries her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), making [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realize how deeply she loves the girl. During her seven weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives many visitors and eagerly anticipates returning to school under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. ## CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and thrives under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically talks to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) about her schoolwork and field trips, though [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains critical. Later, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) proposes organizing a Christmas concert to raise money for a school flag, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) embraces wholeheartedly despite Marilla's skepticism and Matthew's encouraging support.

## CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Harris](../character/harris.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — Noticing how plain Anne's clothes are compared to other girls', [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) tries to buy her a trendy puffed-sleeve dress at a [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) shop, but gets so intimidated by the clerk that he ends up buying rakes, seed, and sugar instead. He enlists Mrs. Lynde's help to buy and sew the fashionable brown dress, which he presents to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a snowy Christmas morning alongside a pair of slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed by the gifts and goes on to star in the successful [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Christmas concert.

The evening concert is a huge success, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) performing wonderfully in her new dress. Afterward, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) discuss how proud they are of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and consider her future education.

## CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), Green Gables, [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comes home to find tea not prepared and learns that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dyed her hair green using dye bought from a peddler. ## CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends re-enact [Elaine](../character/elaine.md) on a leaky flat boat, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stranded on a bridge pile when the boat sinks. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescues her in a dory, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) coldly rejects his attempt to apologize and become friends. Back home, after discussing the day's lesson on avoiding over-romanticism with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) quietly encourages [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to keep a little romance.

## CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) invites [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to visit [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). After getting permission, the girls spend a delightful week attending the fair, visiting the park, and seeing a concert before returning home.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. **[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) bids farewell to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), reflecting fondly on how Anne's presence brought life into her home. The girls enjoy a scenic drive back to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a warm welcome and a special dinner from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P33](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P35](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P38](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0038)_

## CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an extra class to prepare advanced students for Queen's entrance examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) join, which delights her. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joins her classmates in the new study group, though she regrets Diana's absence and finds herself missing Gilbert's attention despite their fierce academic rivalry.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P25](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0025)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secretly regrets her ongoing feud with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), though the two remain intense academic rivals. Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return to teach next year, relieved students pack away their studies, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to enjoy her summer before growing up. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), expressing her relief over Matthew's health and admitting to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has matured.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P25](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043)_

## CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a restful summer outdoors before returning to her studies, discussing her growing maturity and moral thoughts with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). As the Queen's class prepares for the fateful [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations under Miss Stacy's guidance, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices Anne's rapid physical growth and quiet demeanor, sharing her fears of losing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P0](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P10](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P16](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P20](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0020)_

## CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) and returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to anxiously await the results. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings news that the pass list is out and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has tied for first place on the Island with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her joyful success with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), concluding the evening with a peaceful visit to Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P25](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P38](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P44](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0044)_

## CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Billy](../character/billy.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Evans](../character/evans.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress for her recital at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) pops in to offer her own proud yet gruff commentary. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rides to the hotel with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Billy](../character/billy.md), where she experiences severe stage fright before performing. After catching sight of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds her courage, gives an outstanding performance that earns an encore, and enjoys the post-concert reception.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Evans](../character/evans.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Billy](../character/billy.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md)** — After a successful encore and compliment-filled supper, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) head home with [Billy](../character/billy.md). During the ride, [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share compliments and express envy of the wealthy hotel guests, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) asserts her contentment with who she is and the love she has back at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P38](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P43](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P48](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0048)_

## CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) with help from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), who buy her a green evening dress. After moving to town, she attends her first day at the [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and their [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classmates, only to face intense homesickness in her boarding house until [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and Ruby visit.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P0](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P3](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P15](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0015)_

## CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Frank Stockley](../character/frank-stockley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) settles into student life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), forming new friendships with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) while keeping up her academic rivalry with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She spends visits with [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) and keeps her exams in perspective as commencement approaches.

## CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns she has won the Avery scholarship while [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal. After graduating, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where she notices Matthew's failing health and learns about potential financial trouble with the Abbey Bank. [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) lovingly tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) he is prouder of her than he would be of a dozen boys.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P17](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P28](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. ## CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Martin](../character/martin.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) collapses and dies suddenly after reading news of the bank failure. The household and community mourn his death, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) express their deep love for each other in their shared grief. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about coping with sorrow and moving forward.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P17](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. ## CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learns from an oculist that her eyesight is failing, prompting her to consider selling [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to let the home be sold, revealing her decision to forgo her college scholarship and remain in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to teach and care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) later informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school position for her, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reconcile with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and become close friends with him.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII.
